title: A man named Bernie proposes ESP as a savant skill in non-speaking autistic people
summary: Ky Dickens tells of A man named Bernie proposes ESP as a savant skill in non-speaking autistic people, about unspecified at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A documentary filmmaker, Ky Dickens, who made a film about telepathy in children, says a man named Bernie first came up with an idea about non-speaking autistic people. The idea is that ESP, meaning extrasensory perception or sensing things beyond the ordinary senses, might be one of the special savant skills some of them have. She also mentions a psychiatrist, Diane Powell, in connection with it.
